This document out lines the testing procedures 
P1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The fire alarm system was designed following the 
supplied specifications. It consists of one main panel located in the steam 
turbine building with 39 zones, including 4 zones in the machine shop/spare 
parts building, 3 zones in the circulating pump house, 1 zone in the combustible 
fuels storage building and 20 zones in the turbine building. In addition, 11 
zones are supplied to be connected to by others

Sensor energized when smoke occur in any zone 
which cause current increasing through wires to fire alarm panel ( simplex ) 
with appearing alarm in smoke zone

The first 
draft initiated by eng. Wagdy Eid Mansour, tested by eng. Marwa El-Hadidy, 
safety eng. Ashraf Gaber at 19 March 2005, reviewed by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Abd El-Menem El-Emam, quality Safety eng. Medhat Khater, accepted by general 
director eng. Yousry Abd El-Maksuod, and approved by eng. Awad Fathy head sector 
of Talkha PS.

This document 
accepted by
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& Financial 
quality control, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control Head 
sector.
